title: Tell HMRC your Inheritance Tax scheme reference number
text:
Use this form if you expect to have an Inheritance Tax advantage and have received an 8-digit scheme reference number from any of the following:

 • HMRC

 • a scheme promoter

 • a person involved in the supply of the arrangements

 • the client of a scheme promoter

 You can tell HMRC the scheme reference number by completing the postal form.

 Email HMRC to  ask for this form in Welsh (Cymraeg) .

 Before you start

 The postal form is interactive (one that you complete on screen) and you must use Adobe Reader to complete it.

 Contact the Online Services Helpdesk if you have problems opening or saving the form.
changeNote: The online AAG4(IHT) form submission information has been removed as form AAG4(IHT) can only be submitted by post.
